title: Comparing Numbers to 10
short: Tell which of two written numbers is greater.

blocks.html: When you compare groups by counting, you are comparing numbers. You can read numerals, so let’s compare them.

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: 7 comes later than 3 when we count, so 7 is greater.

blocks.html: The number you say later when counting is greater. The one you say earlier is less.
Each counting number is one more than the one before. So every step forward makes a bigger group, and later numbers mean more.

blocks.title: Which is greater?
steps: 8 is greater than 5. 5 is less than 8.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Play a dice game: each person rolls, and the greater number wins the round. Use the words “greater than” and “less than.”
